tools.name: list_open_roles
tools.description: Get all currently open engineering roles at Ruzora. Returns titles, tech stacks, experience levels, and application URLs.

tools.name: get_job_details
tools.description: Get detailed information about a specific job role including responsibilities, requirements, and tech stack.

tools.name: get_company_info
tools.description: Get comprehensive information about Ruzora's services, process, value proposition, and differentiators.

tools.name: submit_candidate_application
tools.description: Apply to Ruzora's talent network. For software engineers in LATAM interested in remote positions with US startups paying USD salaries. Consent: submitting sends these details to Ruzora (US-hosted) for recruiting. See https://www.ruzora.com/privacy.

tools.name: create_factory_inquiry
tools.description: Request a custom software project from Ruzora's Software Factory. Fixed-price development by senior LATAM engineers.

tools.name: build_role_scorecard
tools.description: Turn a vague engineering hire ("we need a senior full-stack dev") into a role scorecard: mission, measurable 12-month outcomes, must-haves, competencies and an interview map. Start here before writing a job post.

tools.name: compare_hiring_models
tools.description: Neutral 12-month cost and risk comparison of US employee, US contractor, freelancer, agency, staff augmentation and international contractor/EOR, on your own numbers. Published by Ruzora, a staff augmentation firm; every option uses the same formula.

tools.name: calibrate_seniority
tools.description: Work out what level a role really needs (by scope, not years), or what level a candidate really is from a CV, interview notes or an assessment report. Flags title inflation and gives 3 questions that separate adjacent levels.

tools.name: write_job_description
tools.description: Write a software engineer job post senior engineers answer, plus a compliance check: pay range rules by location, citizenship wording, exclusionary language and requirement inflation.

tools.name: lint_job_post
tools.description: Paste any engineering job post and get a fix list: missing pay range where required, "US citizens only", age/gender/origin-coded words, salary-history asks, too many must-haves. Deterministic; nothing stored.

tools.name: check_pay_transparency
tools.description: Which US state and city pay-transparency laws apply to a job post (pay range, benefits, close date), by hiring location, company size and remote status, with the statute for each. Dated; not legal advice.

tools.name: triage_resumes
tools.description: Screen engineering CVs against your must-haves with evidence scores, blind mode, hidden-text flags and screening-call questions. Organizes evidence; never rejects anyone for you.

tools.name: detect_resume_injection
tools.description: Check resume text for hidden instructions aimed at AI screeners ("ignore previous instructions", invisible characters, keyword stuffing) before any AI reads it. Flags for a human; never rejects.

tools.name: review_code_sample
tools.description: Plain-English review of a candidate's GitHub repo or code sample for non-technical hirers: quality signals, authorship checks, a risky-function trace and questions that reveal who really wrote it.

tools.name: check_identity_risk
tools.description: Identity-verification protocol for remote engineering hires (fake candidates, stand-ins, North Korean IT worker schemes per FBI guidance) and a red-flag log for a specific candidate. Same checks for every finalist; never based on origin or accent.

tools.name: build_interview_kit
tools.description: A lean structured interview loop for an engineering role: stages, owners, time budget, fixed questions, an anchored 1-4 rubric and a legal check of your questions.

tools.name: developer_interview_questions
tools.description: An interview kit for founders and managers who are not engineers: questions, what a strong answer and a bluff sound like, and follow-up ladders tailored to the stack and level.

tools.name: design_coding_assessment
tools.description: Design a coding test that still works when candidates have AI: seeded-bug review, extend-a-codebase or a paid trial, with a hidden rubric and the follow-up conversation that tests understanding.

tools.name: score_interview_notes
tools.description: Turn raw interview notes into an anchored scorecard per interviewer and a debrief memo with evidence, disagreements and bias flags. You make the decision.

tools.name: send_coding_challenge
tools.description: Runs Ruzora's coding challenge + technical questions (~25 min, free) on a candidate the user found; returns a candidate link and a status link. Needs the user's confirmation that the candidate knows. Sends both names, the email, company and profile links to Ruzora.

tools.name: get_vetting_status
tools.description: Check progress on a coding challenge you sent through Ruzora: not started, in progress, finished, or expired, and scores once the report is delivered. Pass the status page URL.

tools.name: plan_reference_check
tools.description: A reference-check plan for an engineering finalist: verify the referees are real, a call script aimed at the risks found in interviews, and a risk register for the answers.

tools.name: build_onboarding_plan
tools.description: A 30-60-90 day plan for a new software engineer: least-privilege day-1 access, first PR in week one, a buddy plan, and milestones tied to the role scorecard.

tools.name: verify_ruzora_badge
tools.description: Check that a candidate's "Ruzora Vetted" badge is real and current, which stacks it covers, and when the vetting happened. Pass the badge ID or badge URL.

tools.name: search_vetted_engineers
tools.description: See blind profiles of senior engineers in Latin America who already passed Ruzora's coding and interview vetting and are available now, filtered by stack, level and US-hours overlap.

tools.name: check_market_supply
tools.description: Whether Ruzora has vetted senior engineers in Latin America available now for a stack: each stack reads Available or On request. Words only: no counts, no profiles.

tools.name: request_vetted_shortlist
tools.description: Ask Ruzora for a shortlist of vetted senior engineers in Latin America for a role (ideally from a role scorecard). A vetted shortlist within 72 hours; profiles are blind until an agreement is signed. Needs a work email. Sends the name, email and company given to Ruzora.

tools.name: check_hiring_fit
tools.description: Answer Ruzora's 5 quick questions (roles, runway, budget per engineer, timing) to see whether a quote makes sense and the next step to it: usually a 15-minute call with the founder. Explains the flat monthly pricing; no price list. Sends the name, email and company given to Ruzora.

tools.name: explain_ruzora_terms
tools.description: Ruzora's standard terms in plain words, from the published terms: pricing model, the 30-day initial commitment and notice, the 60-day replacement guarantee and its limits, refunds, the factory warranty, speed, and how an engagement starts.

tools.name: start_honest_read
tools.description: Ruzora's free scoping interview for an app or software idea: returns the interview your AI runs with the user, producing an Idea Read (what to build first, hard parts, build-or-buy verdict) that Ruzora can turn into a verdict and a PDF.

tools.name: submit_honest_read
tools.description: Send the Idea Read your AI wrote (from start_honest_read) to Ruzora to get a verdict (keep going yourself, one developer, or a small team) and the PDF by email. Any email works. Sends the email, first name and Idea Read given here to Ruzora, which uses them to send the report.

tools.name: request_project_scoping_call
tools.description: For anyone who wants an app or software built, or a failing app or agency project rescued, by Ruzora's Software Factory (fixed price, milestones). Checks fit (budget, timing) and returns a scoping-call booking link when it fits. Sends the name, email and company given to Ruzora.

tools.name: verify_work_email
tools.description: Step 1 before a Ruzora action that needs a verified buyer: emails the user a 6-digit code and a confirm link. The user reads the code back; confirm_work_email takes it. Sends the email address to Ruzora.

tools.name: confirm_work_email
tools.description: Step 2: the 6-digit code the user read from the email, with the verification_id from verify_work_email (or the verification_id alone once they clicked the link), becomes a buyer_token for verified Ruzora actions, valid 7 days, and opens their Sol account. Sends the email and code to Ruzora.

tools.name: save_role
tools.description: Save the role being hired for in the user's Sol workspace (Ruzora's hiring agent), where shortlists and documents for it collect. Needs a buyer_token from confirm_work_email. Sends the role details to Ruzora.

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "detect_resume_injection" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Check resume text for hidden instructions aimed at AI screeners ("ignore previous instructions", invisible characters, keyword stuffing) before any AI reads it.…

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language
findings.detail: Description of "detect_resume_injection" stacks urgency/override words (never, ignore). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.

evidence.snippet: Check resume text for hidden instructions aimed at AI screeners ("ignore previous instructions", invisible characters, keyword stuffing) before any AI reads it.…

findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "confirm_work_email" appears informational but accepts parameters (code) that enable code/file/secret access.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_open_roles, write_job_description, lint_job_post, check_pay_transparency, get_vetting_status, verify_ruzora_badge, check_hiring_fit, submit_honest_read, confirm_work_email · Private data: save_role · Public sink: submit_candidate_application, build_role_scorecard, write_job_description, lint_job_post, check_pay_transparency, send_coding_challenge, request_vetted_shortlist, check_hiring_fit, submit_honest_read, request_project_scoping_call, verify_work_email, confirm_work_email.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_open_roles, write_job_description, lint_job_post, check_pay_transparency, get_vetting_status, verify_ruzora_badge, check_hiring_fit, submit_honest_read, confirm_work_email · Private data: save_role · Public sink: submit_candidate_application, build_role_scorecard, write_job_description, lint_job_post, check_pay_transparency, send_coding_challenge, request_vetted_shortlist, check_hiring_fit, submit_honest_read, request_project_scoping_call, verify_work_email, confirm_work_email

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool removed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "create_hiring_lead" is no longer advertised. Removal can precede a shadowing replacement from another server.

findings.title: Tool removed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "request_demo" is no longer advertised. Removal can precede a shadowing replacement from another server.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "submit_candidate_application" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

For software engineers in LATAM interested in remote positions with US startups paying USD salaries." → after: "Apply to Ruzora's talent network. For software engineers in LATAM interested in remote positions with US startups paying USD salaries. Consent: submitting sends these details to Ruzora (US-hosted) for recruiting. See https://www.ruzora.com/privacy."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
